title: Grandfather Bob Welch the preacher and Welch's instruments
summary: Welch's preacher grandfather played banjo and his grandmother violin; Welch plays six-string guitar and a bit of piano.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Let me know when you want to talk. I mean, when you're ready to cut it. I can ask you. Say, what was your grandfather's name? Bob Welch. Bob Welch. Yes, sir. Same as yours, just about. Yes, sir. Oh, I see. And, uh, did he play with bands?
No, sir. He was a preacher. He died a preacher.
And he played five-string banjo? Did he play it in church?
Did you get a chance to play?

Well, uh... He just had it around the house. Well, uh, he never... They'd go off playing on, but he just had it and had him a violin. So him and my mother, my grandmother, and we used to get together. He'd play the banjo and she'd play the violin. Then they'd change up. They'd have them old... Little old flang-dangs, as you call them.
Well, what kind of music would they play?
Well, uh, at that time, it was that old way back music.
Was it hymns, or was it simple songs?

Well, no, it was hymns. Yeah, okay. Calling what? Calling it. It figures. You know... Figures. Oh. Just go around the more round dances. You know, around the rang. Mm-hmm. They hold one other... Yeah.
Do you know, uh, any reels? What do you call reels? Quadrills, mazookas? No, sir. Those set dances is what you're talking about. Yes, sir. Do you know any of those?
No, sir, I don't. It's been so long.
You couldn't even give us a piece of one, huh?
I'll try to think of one.
Yeah, well, you know, if you could just give us a piece, it would be interesting to hear it.

Come on. Good piece of one would be worth more than a whole bad song, you know? It's right, you know? Just a little bit of a good one would really be something. good. Uh... Now... Let me see now. You told about playing with some bands, and you say you played five-string banjo? Yes. Six-string guitar or twelve-string? Six-string guitar. Always. Yes, sir. And any other instruments?
No, sir, never did none. None of the rest. Of course, I play piano a little bit, but I never did play enough to do no good.
